a.xlink:title: NetX Duo network driver bound to the ESP32-C6 link (ra8_c6link).
NetX Duo network driver shim that bridges onto the ESP32-C6 link.
The single integration boundary between this firmware and the ESP32-C6.
Public entry point of the RA8D2 + ThreadX port of esp-hosted.
The one seam between ra8_c6link and the wire that reaches the C6.
Allocation-free constants shared by the RA8 and C6 media endpoints.
